event_data: {"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:56:41+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wow... this place looks so different at night."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:56:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "S\u00ed, mijita. I can hear you on the comms."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:56:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Keep exploring. Your driver's test is almost done."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:56:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "A few more seconds, and the computer will be able to calculate your score."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:56:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Just... don't tell Mom I'm out here, okay?"}
{"node_id": "act1.tutorialMove", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:56:51+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Use the Mouse, the Arrow Keys, or the [W][A][S][D] keys to move your Sub."}
{"node_id": "act1.intro-part2", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:06+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Sweetie, what were you thinking?? Taking the sub out at night, after last time?"}
{"node_id": "act1.EnterStation", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:35+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Uh oh. Mom doesn't look too happy."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Rico, I can't believe you let her take the sub out at night."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "She's on probation! She could've crashed again, she could've gotten lost\u2014\u2014"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:51+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "And just in time. I could use your help around here."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:52+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Here? But... what about the Nautilus mission?"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:53+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I want to help find the Challenger Deep!"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:53+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Oh, Mija. I'm sorry. That mission already left last night."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:53+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Besides, the Lower Depths are too dangerous."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:54+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You can do so much good right here!"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:57:55+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Sun's almost up. Let's get you started with your first job."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.start", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:12:55+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Okay, Mija. You already identified all the species here at Site C."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.start", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:12:56+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Now you'll need to head to Site A, Rodeo Cove, and do the same thing."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:13:53+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wow, Rodeo Cove! My sister used to bring me here when I was little."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:13:55+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I wonder if Ovid the Otter still lives here. He was my favorite."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:13:56+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "According to my database, male sea otters live an average of 10 to 15 years in the wild..."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:13:56+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "So there is a 15.8% chance that Ovid is still alive!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:13:57+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Gee. Thanks for that cheery thought, V1ct0r."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.introQuestion", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:17:24+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What behaviors did you learn about Bull Kelp in Site A?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.done", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:17:35+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Just like here at the Forested Lagoon, Sea Otters eat the Urchins."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:17:35+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You've proven that both Bull Kelp and Giant Kelp provide energy to their ecosystems."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:17:35+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Does that mean I can take a job at another station?"}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:17:36+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "But are you sure you don't want to stay here? You're still so new at this."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-06-01T17:17:37+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "No te preocupes, Mom. I'll be careful."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.mackBackstory", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:06:44+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Oh, she was the mechanic here before me."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.mackBackstory", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:06:45+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "She's awesome, but she got fed up of all the fighting."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.mackBackstory", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:06:45+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Took off a couple weeks ago to join the Nautilus crew."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.mackBackstory", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:06:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wait... really? My friend Sam is on the Nautilus!"}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.mackBackstory", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:06:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Sam must be super adventurous. That mission is definitely not for the faint of heart."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.mackBackstory", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:06:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "But, ya know. Somebody's gotta build a new comms array. Lucky me."}

{"node_id": "WorldMap.WorldMapLeaving.2", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:07:45+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Auto-pilot destination set for Coral Reef Research Station."}
{"node_id": "WorldMap.WorldMapLeaving.2", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:07:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We will arrive at our destination tomorrow."}

{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FourthDream", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:09:33+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Um... nothing. Just wanted to make sure you were still there."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FourthDream", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:09:35+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Let's get off this ship and take on a new job. I need to be around people."}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.1", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:10:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Sensors indicate that the anomaly was sent by Challenger Deep."}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.1", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:10:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "That's where Sam is! They must've gotten the probe back online!"}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.1", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:10:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "But why would they send this to us?"}
{"node_id": "RS-2V.OnScanFishers", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:11:39+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hey! Why are you messing with my line?"}
{"node_id": "RS-2V.OnScanFishers", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:11:41+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What? No no, we were just scanning it."}
{"node_id": "RS-2V.OnScanFishers", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:11:43+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Oh, okay. So you're a scientist around here?"}
{"node_id": "RS-2V.OnScanFishers", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:11:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Yep! Catching some Red Grouper out here today."}
{"node_id": "RS-2V.OnScanFishers", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:11:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Oh, interesting! Mind telling me how much you catch on average?"}

{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.arrival", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:18+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Welcome to our station. Come and check in with us over here!"}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Yeah, yeah. Serenity Meadows, the happiest ecosystem on Earth."}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:22+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Except for the killer Lionfish who are literally ruining everything."}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:23+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Oh, um... is this a bad time?"}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:24+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Not at all. You must be Ollie."}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:26+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I hope you like turtles, O. He's obsessed."}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:28+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We maintain a few different sites. I'll send you the coordinates."}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:33+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Um... what was that about killer Lionfish?"}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:34+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "No need to worry, O. Serenity Meadows is perfectly safe."}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:34+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Unless you're allergic to Lionfish, like me. Then it's a death trap."}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:35+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "If the Lionfish are causing trouble, we'll figure it out."}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:36+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Let me know if you'd like to view the job board!"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.coral.jobGiver.noJob.a", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hello again, O! Would you like to see the Job Board?"}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.start", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:17:58+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I need an updated count of the Loggerhead Turtle population here at Site V."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.start", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:18:02+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Can you help out with that, Ollie?"}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.start", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:18:05+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hmm? Oh, yes. You'll need to go outside and use your Scanner to locate a Turtle."}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.start", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:18:05+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Then switch to Counting mode and get a representative sample of the Turtle population."}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.start", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:18:06+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Though, it looks like you've already scanned a Turtle. So all that's left to do is count them."}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.navigation.return", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:18:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hmm. It appears you didn't get a representative count of the Turtles."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.navigation.return", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:18:17+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I would suggest returning to Site V."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:18:40+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "No wonder Prof. Cempaka calls his station Serenity Meadows."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:18:40+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "There's something so calming about this place."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:18:41+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Yes. And so much new data to gather!"}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.navigation.goBackUp", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:19:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Ooh, that was great. I love Count Mode."}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.navigation.goBackUp", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:19:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I knew you'd come around to the thrill of obtaining new data, O!"}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.navigation.goBackUp", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:19:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Should we continue gathering more? Perhaps another count, just to be safe?"}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.navigation.goBackUp", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:19:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Sorry, V. I think Prof. Cempaka is waiting for us."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.coral.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:21:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hello! Do you have anything to report for your current job?"}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.argue.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:21:24+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Let's see what you found out, O."}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.argue.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:21:38+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What is the current Loggerhead Turtle population at Serenity Meadow? (It should be in the Sites tab of AQOS.)"}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.end", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:22:08+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "\u00bfTienes otros trabajos por aqu\u00ed? I'd love to keep exploring this place. Plus, my A.I. is jonesing for some data."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.end", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:22:09+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hmmmm. Yes. We could always use the help."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.end", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:22:10+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "There's a new population to study by the reef edge."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.end", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:22:13+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "And, well. You heard Sofia's concerns over the Lionfish."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.end", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:22:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Feel free to check the job board to see what's available."}

{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.end", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:22:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "...Though looking at your sub, you may need some new capabilities before you are ready to take any of them on."}
{"node_id": "job.coral-turtle-population.end", "server_time": "2026-06-03T16:22:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Once you've saved some more money, consider stopping by Sofia's shop."}

{"node_id": "partner.talk.help.noJob.default.2", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:44:40+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Me pregunto si hay trabajos disponibles que podamos aceptar..."}

{"node_id": "partner.talk.help.noJob.notAtHelm", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:47:55+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "\u00a1Tenemos que dirigirnos a una estaci\u00f3n de investigaci\u00f3n y aceptar un trabajo!"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:01+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Vaya, vaya, vaya. \u00a1Por f\u00edn, sangre nueva por aqu\u00ed!"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:02+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Bienvenida a la Estaci\u00f3n del Pantano, Srta. Ram\u00edrez."}

{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:06+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Ese arrecife de all\u00e1, en la plataforma petrol\u00edfera... nunca he visto algo as\u00ed."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:10+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Me enviaron aqu\u00ed para decidir qu\u00e9 se debe hacer de ello."}

{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:14+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Bueno, \u00a1pues, es obvio que la plataforma se tiene que desaparecer! \u00bfPor qu\u00e9 estamos perdiendo el tiempo con esto?"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:25+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Silias, la plataforma no es asunto tuyo."}

{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:25+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Todav\u00eda estoy esperando tu reporte sobre el accidente con la torre de comunicaciones."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:25+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Te lo sigo diciendo, Profesora. Esa explosi\u00f3n no fue culpa m\u00eda."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:25+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Espera un segundito... \u00bfsu torre de comunicaciones explot\u00f3??"}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:43+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Empezamos a evaluar si el arrecife de la plataforma petrol\u00edfera puede permanecer sin da\u00f1ar el ecosistema, o si hay que retirarlo."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:43+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Lo primero es estimar las poblaciones de los organismos."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:49:45+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Eso nos permitir\u00e1 comparar las poblaciones de especies aut\u00f3ctonas con las especies invasoras que la plataforma ha permitido que vivan aqu\u00ed."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:50:09+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Tambi\u00e9n podremos utilizar esos datos como referencia para futuros modelos."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:50:11+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "\u00bfPuedes sacar tu submarino y hacer un recuento estimado de todas las especies que hay aqu\u00ed?"}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:50:58+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Esto es tan chido. Un ecosistema completamente nuevo creciendo en una vieja plataforma petrol\u00edfera."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:51:03+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Aunque ese fulano, Silias, no parece muy contento."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:51:09+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Registros encontrados. Estimado cient\u00edfico marino. El m\u00e1s joven de una larga familia de camaroneros."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:51:13+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Humanos que se ganan la vida pescando gambas."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:51:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hmm. No he visto muchas gambas por aqu\u00ed."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-06-01T12:51:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "No me sorprende que ese fulano sea un gru\u00f1\u00f3n."}

{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:02:26+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "S\u00ed, mijita. I can hear you on the comms."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:02:34+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Keep exploring. Your driver's test is almost done."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:02:52+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "A few more seconds, and the computer will be able to calculate your score."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:02:57+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Just... don't tell Mom I'm out here, okay?"}
{"node_id": "act1.tutorialMove", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:03:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Use the Mouse, the Arrow Keys, or the [W][A][S][D] keys to move your Sub."}
{"node_id": "act1.intro-part2", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:03:54+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Sweetie, what were you thinking?? Taking the sub out at night, after last time?"}
{"node_id": "act1.EnterStation", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:04:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Uh oh. Mom doesn't look too happy."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:04:37+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Rico, I can't believe you let her take the sub out at night."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:04:58+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "She's on probation! She could've crashed again, she could've gotten lost\u2014\u2014"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:05:07+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "And just in time. I could use your help around here."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:05:09+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Here? But... what about the Nautilus mission?"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:05:14+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I want to help find the Challenger Deep!"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:05:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Oh, Mija. I'm sorry. That mission already left last night."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:05:25+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Besides, the Lower Depths are too dangerous."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:05:26+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You can do so much good right here!"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-06-01T16:05:28+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Sun's almost up. Let's get you started with your first job."}

event_data: {"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:19+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wow... this place looks so different at night."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "S\u00ed, mijita. I can hear you on the comms."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Keep exploring. Your driver's test is almost done."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "A few more seconds, and the computer will be able to calculate your score."}
{"node_id": "act1.checkIntro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Just... don't tell Mom I'm out here, okay?"}
{"node_id": "act1.tutorialMove", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:25+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Use the Mouse, the Arrow Keys, or the [W][A][S][D] keys to move your Sub."}
{"node_id": "act1.intro-part2", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:36+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Sweetie, what were you thinking?? Taking the sub out at night, after last time?"}
{"node_id": "act1.EnterStation", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Uh oh. Mom doesn't look too happy."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:50+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Rico, I can't believe you let her take the sub out at night."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:50+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "She's on probation! She could've crashed again, she could've gotten lost\u2014\u2014"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:51+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "And just in time. I could use your help around here."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:51+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Here? But... what about the Nautilus mission?"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:36:51+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I want to help find the Challenger Deep!"}

event_data: {"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:39:22+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "With your help, we might actually be able to get the Kelp Refuge up and running!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:39:22+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Your sister used to love this place. I can't think of a better way to honor her."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:39:22+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What about the other research stations? Do they need help, too?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:39:23+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "For now, I'd rather have you stay closer to home. Just in case."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:39:23+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Never mind, Sweetie. Let's get you set up with your next job!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:39:23+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Talk to me to view your Job Board whenever you're ready."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.jobGiver.noJob.a", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:39:49+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Would you like to see the Job Board, Mija?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.start", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:39:55+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Okay, Mija. You already identified all the species here at Site C."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.start", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:39:56+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Now you'll need to head to Site A, Rodeo Cove, and do the same thing."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:40:14+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wow, Rodeo Cove! My sister used to bring me here when I was little."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:40:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I wonder if Ovid the Otter still lives here. He was my favorite."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:40:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "According to my database, male sea otters live an average of 10 to 15 years in the wild..."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:40:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "So there is a 15.8% chance that Ovid is still alive!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:40:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Gee. Thanks for that cheery thought, V1ct0r."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.introQuestion", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:08+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wonderful, Mija! And you're back so soon!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.introQuestion", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:09+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What behaviors did you learn about Bull Kelp in Site A?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.done", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Just like here at the Forested Lagoon, Sea Otters eat the Urchins."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:15+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You've proven that both Bull Kelp and Giant Kelp provide energy to their ecosystems."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Does that mean I can take a job at another station?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Well... if that's what you really want."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "But are you sure you don't want to stay here? You're still so new at this."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:16+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "No te preocupes, Mom. I'll be careful."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:17+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I'll have V1ct0r update the map aboard your AquaLab."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:17+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "In the meantime, stop by your uncle's shop. You'll need some upgrades."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:33+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What do you think of V1ct0r? Pretty sweet A.I., right?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:33+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "His love of data was Mer's idea."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:33+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "\u00a1Claro que s\u00ed! Didn't I tell you?"}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.ContinueAfterTioVictorJournal", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:37+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Now that you and V1ct0r will be traveling outside the Kelp Forest, you'll need some upgrades."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.ContinueAfterTioVictorJournal", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:38+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You still only have Level 1 clearance, so you'll need to stick to the basics for now."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.open.a", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:41+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Anything you want to learn more about?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.ROVTagger", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:43+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Population Count Mode! Simple, but really useful."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.ROVTagger", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:43+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You can switch on Population Count Mode when you're out in your sub."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.ROVTagger", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:44+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "When you move close to a species you've already scanned, Population Count Mode will count them."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.ROVTagger", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:44+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Count enough organisms, and it'll give you a population estimate!"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.ROVTagger", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:44+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "MUCH faster than counting each critter by hand."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.unlockHintSomewhere", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:45+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "This would unlock some jobs over at the Coral Reef Research Station!"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.openExplore.b", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Any upgrades you want for your sub?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.VisualModel", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:51+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "The Visual Modeling! Every scientist needs one of these."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.VisualModel", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:52+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Use it to create visual models and understand the interactions between species."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-shop-welcome.gotBothModels", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:41:56+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Nice! Let's head back to the Ship then."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-shop-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:42:13+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I can't believe Mom's letting me leave the Forested Lagoon... by myself!!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-shop-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:42:14+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Your odds of surviving a journey to another research station are 97.2%!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-shop-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:42:14+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Um. Okay, cool. That was a rhetorical question, but I like the optimism."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-shop-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:42:17+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Your map has nearly finished updating! Any second now..."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-shop-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:42:25+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Use the map to view available jobs and travel to different ecosystems."}

{"node_id": "WorldMap.WorldMapLeaving.1", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:42:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Thanks, V1ct0r. I'm going to get some sleep."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FirstDream", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:09+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Good morning. We have arrived at the Bayou Station."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FirstDream", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:10+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "My sensors indicate you are experiencing stress."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FirstDream", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:10+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Yeah. I just had the weirdest dream."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FirstDream", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:11+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Just give me a second... I need to write this down."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.TrunkSequence", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:17+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wait a second... V1ct0r, is that my sister's old trunk?"}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.TrunkSequence", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:18+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wow. She used to keep so many notes and sketches in there!"}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.TrunkSequence", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:18+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Would you like me to digitally scan its contents, O?"}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.TrunkSequence", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:19+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I think I'd like to look through it on my own."}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.generic.tagger.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:40+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Your new Population Count Mode allows you to count species populations."}

{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.generic.tagger.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:41+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Once you've scanned a species, switch to the Population Count Mode and move close to one of them to count it."}

{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.generic.tagger.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:44:42+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Count enough of them and your Population Count Mode will do the rest and give you a population estimate."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:19+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Well, well, well. Finally, some new blood around here!"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Welcome to the Bayou Station, Ms. Ramirez."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Thanks. You can call me Ollie, or just O."}

{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "That reef out there, on the oil rig\u2014\u2014I've never seen anything like it."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I've been stationed here to decide what needs to be done."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Well, obviously the rig needs to go! Why are we wastin' time on this?"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Silias, the rig is not your concern."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I'm still waiting for your report on the comms tower mishap."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I keep tellin' ya, Professor. That explosion wasn't my fault!"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:21+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Wait a sec... your comms tower exploded??"}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:29+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We are beginning an assessment of whether the oil rig reef can stay without harming the ecosystem, or if it needs to be removed."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:29+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "The first step is to estimate organism populations."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:30+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "That will allow us to compare the populations of native species to the invasive species that the rig has enabled to live here."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:30+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We'll also be able to use that data as a baseline for future models."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:31+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Can you take your sub out and get an estimated count of all the species here?"}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:36+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "This is so wild. A whole new ecosystem growing on an old oil rig!"}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:36+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "That Silias guy doesn't seem happy about it, though."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:37+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Records found. Esteemed marine scientist. The youngest in a long line of shrimpers."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:38+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Humans who make a living fishing for shrimp."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:45:38+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hmm. I haven't seen many shrimp around here."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.bayou_alt.jobGiver.wrongCharacter.a", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:09+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Bah, you've got a job with her."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.bayou.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:11+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hey, got anything to report for your current job?"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.bayou.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:19+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "So, do you have anything to report for your current job?"}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.loadArgue1", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:22+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Okay Ollie, let's analyze the data you uncovered for the species at ERC Industries Rig."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.loadArgue1", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:22+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "First, what are the populations for the native species: Loggerhead Turtles and Red Grouper? (They should be in the Sites tab of AQOS.)"}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.loadArgue2", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:34+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "How about the populations of organisms that rely on the rig structure? Those are Elkhorn Coral and Sea Pearls."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.loadArgue3", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:41+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "What other species are there? Those will be the invasive species."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Okay, so you estimate about 15 turtles and 15 grouper."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "That's 30 of the native species overall. And you estimate about 40 Angelfish, which are invasive species."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I would call that about even, maybe a few more invasives. That worries me, because it seems they are set to crowd out the native species."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:46+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We'll need to keep an eye on whether the Angelfish populations increase or remain stable."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I need to consider this and plan our next move."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Aw, you gotta be kiddin' me, Harper."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "The turtles were here first. Then these new critters moved in and started takin' over."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:47+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "If you ask me, we need that reef outta here yesterday! Right, kid?"}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "I'm not really used to making these kind of decisions..."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "It's too early to decide anything, Silias. We need more data."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:47:48+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Ollie, let me know if you'd like to help out again. I'm sure I'll have more work for you soon."}

{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-05-22T15:52:53+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Yeah, yeah. Serenity Meadows, the happiest ecosystem on Earth."}
